why: Seasonal staff hours stay below total hours every week, and a holiday peak of about twice the base week's rentals and hours is believable for resort ski hire.
18 to 62 cans a year per person, cans of 0.2 to 0.8 kg (about 12 to 15 kg a head) and prices above cost are believable canned vegetable figures.
Household incomes of about $4,600 to $24,700 at market rates, with PPP rates below the exchange rates, fit lower-cost markets.
250,000 visits from 120,000 riders, with 20,000 repeat riders averaging about 7.5 visits, is high but possible for a large heritage railway with season-ticket regulars.
Every rating split in the four charts adds to 100%, and a 35,000-person hotel layout survey is believable.
Licence profits of $5m to $16m a year, with non-renewal chances of 20% to 50%, are believable for a toy maker that relies on character ranges.
19 to 70 drinks per cardholder in a half-year is believable, and quintiles fixed on 2013 behaviour can reorder in 2014 (Quintile 2 falling below Quintile 1).
Every mark split in the four charts adds to 100%, and a 51,000-driver concept survey is believable for a carmaker.

The group member counts add to the stated 98k, 152,000 call-outs is about 1.55 per member helped, and costs of £85 to £475 per member are believable (Group E's £85 against a £104 average call-out needs its call-outs to be only about 20% cheaper).
The container flow falls at every stage in both columns, and about 4.6 million containers a month across grocery stores in several cities is believable.
